summary: All 5 new backend integration tests and 2 frontend test changes are value-based and load-bearing. Three negative/regression tests (malformed trigger key, malformed step key, two-null-event-name dedupe) were verified pre-fix failing and post-fix green. Valid-slug round-trip and null-absent draft+activate tests assert real HTTP status codes and response body values via jsonPath. Frontend: ConnectionMode.Strict assertion uses the enum (not a 'strict' literal), guarding against implementation drift. DELAY draft body assertion now checks the actual steps payload (not just call count), eliminating the prior mock-only pattern. No existing coverage weakened. All suites green.

frontend_connectionMode_strict.note: ConnectionMode.Strict === 'strict' at runtime, so behaviorally equivalent pre-fix; the enum form is strictly stronger (catches drift from Strict to another enum value)

frontend_delay_draft_body.note: Promotes the test from mock-only (category 2 bad test) to a value-based body assertion

pyramidBalance.note: New tests are all integration (full HTTP stack via MockMvc + real embedded Mongo). Appropriate test type for validating API-layer security constraints. Frontend changes are component-level mount tests (vitest/nuxt), correctly scoped.
